perception.test: the frame is organised around seeing: camera or light moves, the subject waits

affect.test: a face or body holds a quality/power without yet acting

action.test: a situation provokes an action that changes the situation

reflection.test: an action discloses the situation it happened in

mental.test: the image holds a relation between the beats rather than a deed

break.test: the sensory-motor link snaps: a cut, a blank, a pure optical situation

time.test: duration itself is shown: a hold that outlasts its action
